text:
alex: FYI kickoff with NorthStar Bank tomorrow 10am. They want a 48h POC to validate migration from CompetitorZ. Scope: compat shim for inline tool calls, prompt/response parity on a 250-prompt set, cost comparison (short reserved vs hosted), and completed security questionnaire (SAML, VPC peering, BYO-KMS). cc @maria @chen
maria: I can build the adapter. CompetitorZ emits inline tokens like <TASK:lookup id=XYZ>. Plan: prefix+regex detect and map to structured tool calls. Prototype by EOD.
chen: I'll run a diff harness over 250 prompts (mix of short chats, long instructions, and multi-tool sequences). Two runs: default sampling and deterministic (temp=0 + strict stops). ETA ~6h.
patrick: Security asks here: SAML+SCIM, BYO-KMS support, VPC peering, >90d audit log retention, SOC2 report. Need legal for KMS clause.
sec-bot: Security form created: https://redwood.example.com/secforms/northstar-1805. Note: customer requests key-wrapping details attached.
finance: Quick pricing to show: hosted gen $0.017/1k tokens, embeddings $0.0039/1k. Short dedicated trial estimate (pro-rated) ~$8.2k for a 2-node reserve. I'll get an exact PO number.
alex: For the shim, please keep it toggleable and non-destructive. Include a before/after example in the POC deck.
maria: Adapter snippet (prototype): ```regex
^<TASK:(\\w+)(?:\s+([^>]+))?>```
Mapping: extract name + k=v args -> {"tool":"$1","args":{...}}
``` We'll normalize whitespace and stop tokens before diffs.
chen: Early diff stats (first 60 prompts): ~12% token variance default. Deterministic run drops to ~2.8%. Most variance from stop-sequence handling and CompetitorZ's trailing chunked streams. Tool normalization reduces false positives by ~65%. Full CSV + sample pairs will be uploaded.
patrick: Legal/enterprise blocker: they require a data residency clause and audit rights. Legal ETA 48-96h. I'll own this.
finance: NorthStar asked per-token vs per-request pricing and minimum commit tiers. I'll include both options and a discounted 2-week dedicated trial line item.
alex: Owners summary: adapter=maria, diff+reports=chen, pricing=finance, security/legal=patrick, infra peers=infra-team. I'll own customer comms.
infra-team: We can do VPC peering. Need approved CIDR and a billing code. Typical provisioning ~24h after info.
maria: I'll add 30 tool-heavy prompts to the set and one streaming-edge subset to catch chunking differences.
chen: Upload target: https://redwood.example.com/pocs/northstar-1805/diffs. Will post the first full run there.
alex: Make sure POC deliverables include: 1) adapter code + toggle, 2) diff CSV + summary, 3) security questionnaire link, 4) pro-forma PO for trial, 5) one before/after mapping example.
patrick: Noted. Legal will need the BYO-KMS flow explained in the POC doc (how keys are wrapped and logs retained).
finance: I'll draft the demo PO and include both per-token and per-request examples.
maria: Quick example for deck (inline -> structured): Original: "Order: <TASK:charge id=42 amount=100/>" -> Mapped: {"tool":"charge","args":{"id":"42","amount":100}}. Include token delta.
alex: :thumbsup: Good. Reconvene after chen's run. I'll update NorthStar post-10am kickoff.
